source_id.Description: Subject identifier used in the Zenodo release and the FieldTrip protocol.

n_ecog_electrodes.Description: Number of ECoG electrodes, Stolk et al. 2018 Nat Protoc 13:1699 doi:10.1038/s41596-018-0009-6 (PMC6548463): "neural recordings from 96 ECoG and 56 SEEG electrodes that were implanted as part of the preparation for the epilepsy surgery". Equals the ECOG rows of channels.tsv.

n_seeg_electrodes.Description: Number of SEEG electrodes, same source. Equals the SEEG rows of channels.tsv.
